product_overview: A production-ready personal finance tracker that provides accurate monthly totals, category breakdowns, and optional bank syncing via Plaid to reduce manual entry. Security, idempotent syncing, and explainability are prioritized to build user trust in the data.
core_goals: Give users a simple, trustworthy view of spending, income, and net change with accurate monthly totals.
Minimize manual work by supporting Plaid bank connections and idempotent transaction syncs (initial import + incremental).
Enforce security and privacy: server-only tokens, RLS in DB, and no client access to secret tokens.
Ensure data correctness and explainability (no duplicate transactions, pending vs posted handling, auditability).
Provide a smooth onboarding and verified sessions flow (signup → verify email → dashboard).

features.name: User Authentication - Login
features.description: Authenticate returning users with email and password (Supabase). Successful login yields a verified session and redirects to the protected dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email in email input field -> Enter password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See redirect to /dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email in email input field -> Enter incorrect password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See error message indicating invalid credentials

Navigate to /login -> Enter email for an unverified account in email input field -> Enter password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See message instructing to verify email and/or redirect to /verify-email

features.name: User Authentication - Signup
features.description: Register new users using email and password. After successful signup the user is prompted to verify email before accessing protected pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter email in email input field -> Enter password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See redirect to /verify-email -> Check email for verification link
Navigate to /signup -> Enter email that is already registered in email input field -> Enter password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See error message that email is already in use
Navigate to /signup -> Enter invalid email format in email input field -> Enter password in password input field -> Click Submit button -> See validation error message

features.name: Email Verification
features.description: Confirm user email addresses after signup. The confirmation flow uses a server callback route to finalize verification before allowing login.
user_flows: Receive verification email -> Click verification link in email -> Browser requests /auth/confirm -> See confirmation success message -> Navigate to /login

Receive verification email -> Click expired or invalid verification link in email -> Browser requests /auth/confirm -> See error message about invalid/expired token -> See prompt to resend verification

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: Protected user dashboard that displays initial data (monthly totals, category breakdowns) fetched from the server and provides controls for filtering and interacting with the data.
user_flows: Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See dashboard with initial data loaded from server -> Click a date range filter control -> See dashboard update with filtered results
Navigate to /dashboard without active session -> See redirect to /login
Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> See loading state -> See error message if initial /api/dashboard fetch fails

features.name: Bank Connection - Plaid Integration
features.description: Allow authenticated users to connect bank accounts using Plaid Link. The client requests a server-generated link token, opens Plaid Link, receives a public_token, and sends it to the server to exchange for a stored item and access secret; the server then imports accounts and transactions.
user_flows: Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /connect-bank -> Click Connect bank button -> Client requests POST /api/plaid/link-token -> Plaid Link modal appears

Plaid Link modal appears -> Complete institution authorization in Plaid Link -> Client receives public_token -> Client POSTs public_token to POST /api/plaid/exchange -> See success message and connected institution and accounts displayed
Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /connect-bank -> Click Connect bank button -> POST /api/plaid/link-token returns error -> See error message and option to retry
Plaid Link modal appears -> User closes or cancels Plaid Link -> See cancel message and no account added

Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /connect-bank -> Click Sync now button -> Client POSTs to POST /api/plaid/sync-transactions -> See success and last_sync_at update and transactions imported
Click Sync now button -> POST /api/plaid/sync-transactions returns error -> See sync error message and last_sync_status shows error

features.name: Landing Page
features.description: Public marketing landing page that introduces the product, explains how it works, highlights security, and routes new users to signup.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> See hero section with call-to-action -> Scroll through how it works section -> Scroll through security information -> Click Get Started button -> See navigate to /signup
Navigate to / -> Click Get Started button -> Navigation to /signup fails -> See error message and remain on landing page

features.name: Accounts & Transactions (Manual CRUD)
features.description: Support manual accounts and transaction CRUD so users can track cash/checking/credit card accounts without Plaid. Transactions use signed amounts in the DB (expenses negative, income positive); UI shows expense amounts positively for readability.
user_flows: Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Accounts control or tab -> Click Add Account button -> Enter account name and type -> Click Save -> See new account appear in accounts list
Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Accounts control or tab -> Click Add Account button -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See validation error message

Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Transactions control or tab -> Click Add Transaction -> Select account -> Enter date -> Enter amount -> Select category -> Click Save -> See transaction appear in list and dashboard totals update

Authenticate and be signed in -> Navigate to /dashboard -> Click Transactions control or tab -> Click Add Transaction -> Select an account that does not belong to the current user -> Click Save -> See authorization error and transaction is not created
